# featureflip_project (Data Source)

Look up a project by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "featureflip_project" "web" {
  key = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String)

### Read-Only

- `default_flag_lifetime_days` (Number) Default lifetime in days for temporary flags with no expiry of their own, or null when none is set.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
